method: Every question from every paper in this archive is matched to one syllabus topic by keyword rules that were checked by hand. Importance = total marks the topic has carried across all papers (High = top third). Backward-looking only - not a prediction.
summary: 17 papers (2013 to Aug 2025), 272 questions. By total marks the heaviest topics are: Bail: bailable/non-bailable, anticipatory bail, bonds, cancellation; Probation of offenders, admonition and conditional release; Fair trial, speedy trial and presumption of innocence; FIR, complaint, investigation and police diary. Most repeated in the papers from 2022 onwards: FIR, complaint, investigation and police diary (12×); Bail: bailable/non-bailable, anticipatory bail, bonds, cancellation (11×); Juvenile justice: JJB, CWC, rehabilitation, child in conflict with law (10×); Search, seizure and search warrants (9×). This shows what has been asked before; it is not a prediction.
